column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE COMPANIES ACT, NO. 07 OF 2007
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

1.
This Act may be cited as the Companies (Amendment)
Act, No.       of 2019 and shall come into operation on such
date  as  the  Minister  may  appoint  by  Order  published  in
the Gazette.

2.
Section 427 of the Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007
(hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby
amended in paragraph (a) of subsection (3) of that section,
by the substitution for the words and figures “the provisions
of the Registration of Documents Ordinance (Chap. 117)”,
of  the  words  and  figures  “the  provisions  of  the  Secured
Transactions Act, No.    of 2019”.

3.
Section  428  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended as follows:—

(1)
in subsection (3) of that section, by the substitution
for all the words and figures from “registered under
the  Registration  of  Documents  Ordinance
(Chap. 117)” to the end of that subsection, of the
words  and  figures  “registered  under  the  Secured
Transactions Act, No.    of 2019 and the provisions
of  that  Act  shall  apply  in  regard  to  such  floating
charge.”; and
